content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

Which acquisitions are off track on their investment thesis?

content.statement:
WITH __thesis AS (
  SELECT
    company AS th_company,
    lever AS th_lever,
    period AS th_period,
    lever_status AS th_status,
    unit AS th_unit,
    actual_value AS thf_actual,
    target_value AS thf_target
  FROM WIPRO_FINANCE_360_APP.APP_DATA.V_ONTO_THESIS_TRACKING
)
SELECT
  th_company AS company,
  th_lever AS lever,
  MAX(thf_target) AS target_value,
  MAX(thf_actual) AS actual_value,
  th_unit AS unit,
  th_period AS period,
  th_status AS lever_status
FROM __thesis
WHERE
  th_status IN ('OFF_TRACK', 'AT_RISK')
GROUP BY
  th_company,
  th_lever,
  th_unit,
  th_period,
  th_status
ORDER BY
  th_status DESC,
  th_company
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: bcb0d7d1-560c-47a0-a2b6-9a92b37e0088)
;
